info.name: HappyOrNot Customer API v2 alert-comments button-feedbacks API

params.name: surveyId
params.description: Survey id that might have been acquired by using the /surveys endpoint

params.name: experiencePointId
params.description: Experience point id that might have been acquired by using the /experience-points endpoint

params.name: period
params.description: If both period parameter and startDate/endDate are given, latter takes precedence. Week start is always Monday.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Inclusive start date. Defaults to current date. NOTE! startDate->endDate max interval is 1 year.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Exclusive end date. Defaults to tomorrow. NOTE! startDate->endDate max interval is 1 year.

params.name: includeMisuse
params.description: If true, also feedback that has been deemed misuse will be included in the response.

params.name: offset
params.description: Paging parameter to determine the index of the first item from the whole result set matching the search criteria.

params.name: limit
params.description: Paging parameter to determine the maximum size of the result set matching the search criteria.

params.name: order
params.description: Order parameter to sort feedbacks by time.

items.docs: List button feedbacks that match the given parameters
